item.title: Version 0.13.01
item.description:
A richer Movies and Series page, a new app icon, and a tidier update path.

Movies and Series

  • You May Also Like. A shelf of posters under the details, from the same category, with titles that share a genre first. Click one to open it.
  • Fanart backdrop. When your provider supplies one, a faded image sits behind the page.
  • Watch Trailer. A button that opens the trailer in your browser, when the provider lists one.
  • Cast and director as chips. Names wrap neatly onto as many lines as they need instead of one long string.
  • Season picker. Series show one season at a time, chosen from a dropdown. It opens on the season you are watching.
  • Tidier episode rows. Provider prefixes are removed from episode names, with the air date and run time beneath. Stills and descriptions appear when the provider supplies them.
  • Age ratings. A badge appears beside the star rating when the provider sends one (many do not).

Appearance

  • New app icon, a light glass tile with an amber hexagon, also used on the launch, sign-in and About screens and in the sidebar's playlist selector.
  • Refresh menu. The refresh button is now a menu: Refresh All, Refresh Category, Refresh Movies and Refresh Series.
  • Calmer colours. Hearts are red, Event tags match the other tags, and the app's accent is amber throughout, including the Settings tabs.

Updating

  • Updates no longer carry a second copy of the app for the old name. Settings and playlists from before ElBee Player's rename are no longer imported, since that carry-over has long since run.

item.title: Version 0.12.01
item.description:
A new look: an amber theme and a new app icon.

Appearance

  • New app icon. ElBee Player now has the Prism icon: three amber facets on a dark glass tile. It is also the logo on the launch, sign-in and About screens, and the playlist selector in the sidebar shows the prism with your connection status. The smallest sizes use a simplified version so they stay clear.
  • Amber accent. Selection, focus, buttons, progress bars and highlights are now golden amber instead of violet.
  • Active rows glow softly. The selected sidebar entry, category, playing channel and filter pill use a translucent amber fill with a thin amber border.
  • Neutral backgrounds. The window backdrop and sidebar are plain grey glass without the blue and violet tint, and the sidebar icons are one crisp tone that turns amber when selected.
  • Tag pills. Quality tags such as 4K, UHD and HEVC are now subtle translucent pills with a faint border.
  • Diagnostics overlay has an amber hairline border.

item.title: Version 0.11.02
item.description:
Fixes updating to ElBee Player from inside the app. There are no other changes.

Updating

  • Copies installed under the old name can now update. The in-app updater could not install version 0.11.01 on a copy still called LiquidIPTV, and reported the update as improperly signed. That message was misleading: the updater picks the app to install by the installed app's file name, and the rename had changed it. Updates for those copies now carry the app under the name they expect. Your data comes across as described for 0.11.01.
  • The app may keep its old file name in your Applications folder after updating (it still says ElBee Player inside). You can rename it to ElBee Player in Finder at any time. Later updates work either way.
  • Version 0.11.01 can still be downloaded and installed by hand; it simply could not be installed by the updater.
